f.title: Apply for renewal at least nine months before expiry, with ADR and PSUR evaluation
f.statement: A marketing authorisation is valid for five years. f.title: Administrative fines for MAH pharmacovigilance offences (EUR 500 to 25,000)
f.statement: Breaching MAH obligations is an administrative offence under § 138(2); PV-related offences include failing to record or report suspected ADRs (incl. serious ADRs within 15 calendar days), to operate, evaluate with or audit the PV system, to designate the PV responsible person or local representative, to provide the PSMF copy within seven days or benefit-risk data on request, to notify new risks, to inform before public communication, to assess reports, follow up and cooperate on duplicates, to submit PSURs, PASS protocols and final reports, to maintain the PSMF and to operate and update the risk management system. The Ministry of Health imposes fines from EUR 500 to EUR 25,000 for offences under § 138(2)(a)-(ac), (af)-(ay) and (bh)-(bp); fines may be doubled for repeat breaches.
